title: Born in Lahore, Pakistan
description: Aslam Hayat was born on 23 March 1933 in Lahore, Pakistan, with family roots in Subhan Pur, Kapurthala, Punjab.

title: Partition of India
description: Aslam Hayat witnessed the Partition of India as a teenager in Lahore — an experience that shaped his writing and historical outlook throughout his life.

title: Qualified as Chartered Accountant, London
description: He travelled to London, United Kingdom, where he qualified as a Chartered Accountant — the professional foundation for his subsequent public-sector career.

title: Director-level, Pakistan Civil Aviation Authority
description: Over the course of several decades, Aslam Hayat served in increasingly senior leadership positions within the Pakistan Civil Aviation Authority (PCAA), ultimately rising to director-level responsibilities. His career was marked by dedication, integrity, and a commitment to public service.

title: Arrived in Canada
description: Aslam Hayat arrived in Canada in 1989 and settled in Vancouver, British Columbia, where he would remain for the rest of his life.

title: Columnist, The Miracle Newspaper
description: For more than twenty-five years, Aslam Hayat maintained a regular column in The Miracle, Vancouver's Pakistani community newspaper, authoring over 650 articles covering history, current affairs, community issues, personal reflections, and the experiences of the South Asian diaspora.

title: Passed Away in Vancouver
description: Aslam Hayat passed away on 30 May 2026 in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada, aged 93. إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ
